report.explanation: Current telemetry does not substantiate a root cause. Gateway metrics show low error rate (0.001), p95 74ms, zero dependency timeouts and zero db pool waiters; logs show a 200 request_complete. A single gateway trace shows an ERROR span calling order at 915ms, but no order-side telemetry exists to confirm downstream latency. No evidence supports db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, memory-leak, http-500, or bad-configuration. Handing off for order-service evidence.
missing_evidence: Order-service traces/metrics/logs for the same window to confirm or refute downstream latency at order
Order-to-inventory, order-to-payment, and order-to-postgresql span latencies and statuses
Error-rate and p95 metrics for order, inventory, payment, and postgresql services
Log entries from order service showing error details for the failing gateway call
Clarify whether the single ERROR trace is representative or an isolated outlier
